---
name: 💡 Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature for ScaleGuard
title: '[Feature] '
labels: 'enhancement'
assignees: ''
---

## Problem
What problem does this feature solve? (e.g., "I need to route gRPC traffic but ScaleGuard only supports HTTP")

## Proposed solution
Describe the feature you'd like and how it should work.

## Alternatives considered
Any alternative solutions or workarounds you've tried.

## Use case
How would you use this feature? Describe your deployment scenario.

## Willing to contribute?
- [ ] I'd be willing to submit a PR for this feature
- [ ] I can help with testing
- [ ] I can help with documentation

## Additional context
Any other context, mockups, or examples from other tools.
